title: lstmLayer
summary: Create an LSTM layer compatibility object.
description: `lstmLayer(numHiddenUnits)` creates metadata for LSTM recurrent layers.
behaviors: `OutputMode` defaults to `sequence` and can be set to `last` with a name-value option.
Common recurrent-layer options are preserved as properties.

example.input:
layer = lstmLayer(numHiddenUnits)
layer = lstmLayer(numHiddenUnits, Name, Value)

gpu_residency: Layer construction is host metadata work. Host network execution uses a native recurrent kernel; explicit resident inputs are not silently gathered into that host route.
